title: Correct final temperature T2
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (1) must be 297 K (or equivalent).

title: Correct maximum temperature Tmax
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (2) must be 309 K (or equivalent).

title: Force balance on piston
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law to the piston, relating gas pressure, atmospheric pressure, piston weight, and string tension.

title: Force analysis for balance reading
description: Important: The solution must correctly interpret the balance reading to determine the tension in the string connected to the iron block (m2).

title: Application of ideal gas law
description: Important: The solution must recognize the volume is constant and correctly apply the proportional relationship p/T = constant for the sealed gas.

title: Correct pressure calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the gas pressure (p1, p2, p3) from the force balance equations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (Pa, m^2, kg, N) in calculations.

title: Sign error in force equation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly sets up the direction of forces (e.g., wrong sign for pressure difference or tension), leading to an incorrect pressure relation.

title: Misinterpreting balance reading
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student equates the balance reading directly to m2 or fails to account for the tension force correctly (T = (m2 - m_show)g).
